hypothesis: Why GEMSDOE32 B2 (USER-REPORTED 0.2778) ranks above GEMSDOE25/30 (USER-REPORTED 0.2600): B2 equals the GEMSDOE25 dot set with 6,436 catalogue-adjacent dots removed.
mechanism: The official test set is NEW faults not in the USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue (DrivenData problem description). A dot within 2 px of a mapped catalogue trace has near-zero chance of matching an unmapped test fault, so it adds alpha-weighted false-positive mass. Removing those dots lowers FP_w while removing little expected TP_w. This is a mechanism inference, not a measured result.
named_non_fault_mimic: Catalogue-adjacent dots can be correct where a new fault is misaligned or sits on a mapped trace (the rules note misalignment), so removing them can also remove true positives. Holdout cannot separate these cases.
